name: GAN 356 X V2
description: The GAN 356 X V2 is GAN's newest update to the famous GAN 356 X. This new magnetic 3x3 speed cube is outfitted with a matte exterior and shares the same dual adjustment core as GAN's most recent flagship, the GAN 356 XS. Slightly lighter than its predecessor, the GAN 356 X V2 is a fast and smooth cube with modern, easily adjustable settings.
